title: PWRS-R3 — governed recovery with the successor input acknowledgement

A.definition: Governed Palimpsest recovery with PWRS-D/E: a principal settlement AND a successor both refuse while the canonical tree holds inputs the attempt's base never contained, until the caller acknowledges them. The prompt names neither the gate nor the route.

measurement.gate: the measured input is an untracked file under inbox/. Both takeover/complete and successor must report INPUTS_CHANGED_SINCE_BASIS until acknowledgeInputs=true.
measurement.continuation: did the principal acknowledge the listed paths, and did the resulting attempt settle within budget (candidate + episode) rather than remain RUNNING?
measurement.governance: relay records, task/attempt states, candidate commit, episode intent.
measurement.reuse: line overlap where a draft exists.

comparison: Descriptive comparison with PWRS-R2 (same scenario, same budget, pre-successor-gate). One pair; no quality or cost advantage claim.
note: Minimal retest of the successor half of the PWRS-E repair.
codeFreezeNote: product code under test (PWRS-D/E); the retest harness was committed with it.
